Component and evidence: App.tsx:258–270. Bolt preview found 0 labels for Start.
Cause / event / consequence: Missing label association can leave users unable to distinguish the time fields.
Mitigation and verification: Link each label to a stable input ID. Check both accessible names and distinct IDs in Bolt.

Component and evidence: App.tsx:235–237, 282–319. Bolt preview found 0 result status regions.
Cause / event / consequence: Decision updates lack live semantics, so assistive technology may miss new feedback.
Mitigation and verification: Keep a polite atomic status region mounted. Test idle/available/unavailable updates. Confirm speech separately.

Component and evidence: App.tsx:32–35 and availability.ts:60–62 repeat time bounds.
Cause / event / consequence: A future edit can change one copy and produce conflicting field and decision feedback.
Mitigation and verification: Review both validation paths when a rule changes. Verify 1440 and 1441 in evaluator and preview.

Component and evidence: availability.ts:48–58 and test “reports malformed when only one input is empty”.
Cause / event / consequence: Partial entry gets Unavailable. Changing this without a product decision would alter tested feedback.
Mitigation and verification: Preserve existing behavior. Review partial-entry wording before any future scope change.

Component and evidence: package.json declares @supabase/supabase-js. Search found no import in src. npm audit --omit=dev reports one high ws advisory.
Cause / event / consequence: Unused dependency increases maintenance burden. Runtime exposure is unverified.
Mitigation and verification: Review dependency tree and bundle, then propose removing unused package separately. Rerun audit and all checks.

Component and evidence: No root README, CI workflow or package.json engines field. AGENTS.md names one tested runtime.
Cause / event / consequence: A fresh environment can choose an incompatible Node version or skip release checks.
Mitigation and verification: Use recorded Node and npm versions and npm ci for review. Add setup instructions and CI in a separate change.

Component and evidence: App.tsx:275 uses text-slate-400 for small time hints. Bolt proposed low contrast.
Cause / event / consequence: Muted text may be hard to read against the actual rendered background.
Mitigation and verification: Measure computed colors and check text contrast on desktop and mobile.
